plugins.description: A file browser, uploader and downloader for the browser harness, as an ordinary dsh plugin

manifests.description: A file browser, uploader and downloader for the browser harness, as an ordinary dsh plugin
The Network settings page: the CORS proxy this page falls back to, as an ordinary dsh plugin
Installing plugins from the browser, as an ordinary dsh plugin
Choose the machine this session runs on: the Node container, or an emulated PC running DOS, Windows or Linux
A link to this project's repository at the sidebar foot, as an ordinary dsh plugin
A terminal for the browser harness, as an ordinary dsh plugin
dsh-market.com/tryon: deep-link skin application plus the try-on toolbar, running inside the browser dsh shell
DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 插件全家桶。皮肤、宠物与社区插件索引已拆分为独立仓库（dsh-skins / dsh-pet / dsh-community-plugins），本仓通过 npm 包内置它们。
External dsh web GUI plugin: a blank-session git branch selector + Git graph, with real host-side git operations and guards, as a dsh profile bundle

DSH web GUI language pack plugin: registers the Русский language into the locale catalog and centrally carries the ru dictionaries for every family plugin namespace (missing keys fall back to English through the SDK chain).

LiangShen (梁神) agent preset plus its composer lever for the dsh web GUI. The host half declares the bundled preset to the harness's agent-preset registry at activation (declare = enabled), so the preset is selectable for new sessions without writing anything into the harness home; the preset keeps a minimal persona with standing working discipline while the harness's own user-role agent-instructions injection delivers the workspace instructions (the optional `instructionSource: system-prompt` mode lifts them into the prompt instead), and declares one tool presentation for the session's whole lifetime (default `presentation: 'both'`, where the wire collapses to the `run_code` transport and every other tool is reached through the generated SDK; `native` keeps the assembled roster, `ptc` keeps only the transport). High-fan-out tool families (default `mcp__*`) stay paged out of the wire until the preset's own `tool_activate` tool loads their namespace (LRU cap three, state replayed from the durable session event stream), and the tool catalog — exactly the on-wire tools plus paged-out namespace summaries — and a one-line working-context projection travel as durable user messages republished only on change. The browser half adds a slot-machine lever left of the model selector on the new-session screen to toggle the mode. Hot-pluggable via cordis.patch.yml + profile symlink, no dsh source changes.
Workshop browser card: browse skins, pets and community plugins from dsh-market.com and install them in the GUI (assets into the DSH home directories, plugins through the optional plugin manager).

Per-model capability declarations (image input and reasoning efforts) for custom pi-ai providers, edited in place on the Models settings cards; writes the official llm-pi-ai settings namespace, no DSH source changes.

Update checking for the dsh web GUI's official Plugins page: compares installed plugins against the version their registry source serves, gates the update on the DSH runtime minimum the release declares, and drives the update through the official installer channel or this package's loopback CLI gateway.

Scan-to-pair remote access for the dsh web GUI that shares one official interface: a QR beside the settings button pairs phones and PCs into the same Web GUI (a portrait-touch adaptation layer for phones, full desktop on PCs) through one-time tokens and revocable device sessions, with a LAN bind toggle, optional Cloudflare tunnel, and one-click family self-update
Session archive management for DSH Web: centralized inventory, batch archive/restore, physical delete with family cascade, and optional auto-archive / auto-cleanup policies.
DSH web GUI plugin: sidebar-foot Session ID panel listing every session with its full id and one-click copy (browser-only; no source changes).
DSH skill center: browse loaded skills by source (bundled / project / user / custom / runtime), enable or disable, create and delete, in a web GUI panel.

Remote SSH operations for the dsh web GUI: host config store (~/.dsh/dsh-ssh.json, import from ~/.ssh/config), a persistent ssh2 connection pool with jump-host support, exec / PTY web terminal / SFTP transfer / local port-forward tunnels / cluster execution, plus agent tools (ssh_list, ssh_exec, ssh_upload, ssh_download, ssh_tunnel, ssh_cluster). Hot-pluggable — mounted via ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules symlink, no dsh source changes.
External provider extension for the dsh Web GUI task board that synchronizes GitHub Issues into the board; shipped as a dsh profile bundle with no DSH source changes.
Host-authoritative task board for the DSH Web GUI with real session execution, Host cron scheduling, and optional cross-platform idle-sleep protection; mounted without DSH source changes.

Self-update plugin for the dsh web GUI: probes npm for newer family releases and runs the owning profile's pnpm update in place, from a sidebar trigger beside the settings seat with a release-notes panel
Usage statistics plugin for the dsh web GUI: per-provider balance and coding-plan quota detection plus a live token usage ledger, with a compact price glance card above the sidebar's Settings row
DSH Web UI 全家桶聚合插件：一键安装全部功能插件（task-board / git-graph / pet / remote-web-ui / web-ui-settings / skin-center / community-plugins / compat shim）。compat 桥接层已并入本包（src/client），无需独立 compat npm 包。
Web UI plugin group for the dsh settings page: one first-level settings section that hosts the dsh-web family plugins' enable switches and configuration forms.

External dsh web GUI plugin: a blank-session git branch selector + Git graph, with real host-side git operations and guards, as a dsh profile bundle

DSH web GUI language pack plugin: registers the Русский language into the locale catalog and centrally carries the ru dictionaries for every family plugin namespace (missing keys fall back to English through the SDK chain).

LiangShen (梁神) agent preset plus its composer lever for the dsh web GUI. The host half declares the bundled preset to the harness's agent-preset registry at activation (declare = enabled), so the preset is selectable for new sessions without writing anything into the harness home; the preset keeps a minimal persona with standing working discipline while the harness's own user-role agent-instructions injection delivers the workspace instructions (the optional `instructionSource: system-prompt` mode lifts them into the prompt instead), and declares one tool presentation for the session's whole lifetime (default `presentation: 'both'`, where the wire collapses to the `run_code` transport and every other tool is reached through the generated SDK; `native` keeps the assembled roster, `ptc` keeps only the transport). High-fan-out tool families (default `mcp__*`) stay paged out of the wire until the preset's own `tool_activate` tool loads their namespace (LRU cap three, state replayed from the durable session event stream), and the tool catalog — exactly the on-wire tools plus paged-out namespace summaries — and a one-line working-context projection travel as durable user messages republished only on change. The browser half adds a slot-machine lever left of the model selector on the new-session screen to toggle the mode. Hot-pluggable via cordis.patch.yml + profile symlink, no dsh source changes.
Workshop browser card: browse skins, pets and community plugins from dsh-market.com and install them in the GUI (assets into the DSH home directories, plugins through the optional plugin manager).

Per-model capability declarations (image input and reasoning efforts) for custom pi-ai providers, edited in place on the Models settings cards; writes the official llm-pi-ai settings namespace, no DSH source changes.

Update checking for the dsh web GUI's official Plugins page: compares installed plugins against the version their registry source serves, gates the update on the DSH runtime minimum the release declares, and drives the update through the official installer channel or this package's loopback CLI gateway.

Scan-to-pair remote access for the dsh web GUI that shares one official interface: a QR beside the settings button pairs phones and PCs into the same Web GUI (a portrait-touch adaptation layer for phones, full desktop on PCs) through one-time tokens and revocable device sessions, with a LAN bind toggle, optional Cloudflare tunnel, and one-click family self-update
Session archive management for DSH Web: centralized inventory, batch archive/restore, physical delete with family cascade, and optional auto-archive / auto-cleanup policies.
DSH web GUI plugin: sidebar-foot Session ID panel listing every session with its full id and one-click copy (browser-only; no source changes).
DSH skill center: browse loaded skills by source (bundled / project / user / custom / runtime), enable or disable, create and delete, in a web GUI panel.

Remote SSH operations for the dsh web GUI: host config store (~/.dsh/dsh-ssh.json, import from ~/.ssh/config), a persistent ssh2 connection pool with jump-host support, exec / PTY web terminal / SFTP transfer / local port-forward tunnels / cluster execution, plus agent tools (ssh_list, ssh_exec, ssh_upload, ssh_download, ssh_tunnel, ssh_cluster). Hot-pluggable — mounted via ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules symlink, no dsh source changes.
External provider extension for the dsh Web GUI task board that synchronizes GitHub Issues into the board; shipped as a dsh profile bundle with no DSH source changes.

The host half declares the bundled preset to the harness's agent-preset registry at activation (declare = enabled), so the preset is selectable for new sessions without writing anything into the harness home; the preset keeps a minimal persona with standing working discipline while the harness's own user-role agent-instructions injection delivers the workspace instructions (the optional `instructionSource: system-prompt` mode lifts them into the prompt instead), and declares one tool presentation for the session's whole lifetime (default `presentation: 'both'`, where the wire collapses to the `run_code` transport and every other tool is reached through the generated SDK; `native` keeps the assembled roster, `ptc` keeps only the transport). High-fan-out tool families (default `mcp__*`) stay paged out of the wire until the preset's own `tool_activate` tool loads their namespace (LRU cap three, state replayed from the durable session event stream), and the tool catalog — exactly the on-wire tools plus paged-out namespace summaries — and a one-line working-context projection travel as durable user messages republished only on change. plugins.name: @example/dsh-desktop-compat-example
plugins.description: Open-source Windows desktop client and GUI for DeepSeek Harness — zero-setup installer with Codex, plugins, skills, SSH, mobile remote access, and 11 skins.

manifests.description: DSH web GUI right-panel system: a pixel-faithful re-implementation of AionUi's Explorer + Preview columns (file tree, filename search, git changes, multi-tab preview of 10+ formats) driven by real host-side fs/git services, hot-pluggable via a profile bundle without any dsh source changes
Chat Artifact plugin for DSH: renders safe HTML/CSS/SVG visualizations inline in conversation tool results.
Desktop-only compatibility fixes for DeepSeek Harness queue continuation and cancellation presentation.
Host-only bounded repair agent used by DeepSeek Harness Desktop to fix staged plugin candidates with the user's configured model.

External dsh web GUI plugin: a git branch selector + Git graph in the conversation header's context hole (beside the official workspace selector), with real host-side git operations (switch/create) and guards, as a dsh profile bundle

LiangShen (梁神) agent preset for the dsh web GUI: a two-phase anchored-standard preset — the first model request exposes only the builtin Minimal exact two-tool surface (persistent bash plus str_replace_editor), the one-line persona, and the host sandbox policy needed for valid shell calls; promotion is gated on the first minimal-like reasoning block with a fallback, and the wire then switches to Code Mode (PTC, a single run_code tool over the full registry) with the ordinary injections returning afterwards. The preset files are synced into ~/.dsh/.agent-presets on host startup. Hot-pluggable — mounted via cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules symlink, no dsh source changes.
Live token estimates and generation throughput for DSH Web
Owner-isolated, local-only memory with explicit confirmation and bounded SystemPrompt injection.
A session-header agent mode switcher that applies in place for blank sessions and starts a safe same-workspace session after conversation history exists.
Persisted model pinning and provider ordering for the official DeepSeek Harness model selector.
Page-aware whale particle theme for DeepSeek Harness Web UI
Owner-safe Personal Prompt profiles for DeepSeek Harness using the official SystemPrompt section and variable contracts.
鲸鱼娘宠物插件 for the dsh web GUI: a soft healing whale-girl companion that reacts to model activity (idle/waiting/thinking/tool/done), with petting/feeding interactions and an affinity score
Mobile remote control for the dsh web GUI: scan-to-pair QR entry beside the settings button, one-time pairing tokens, live device status, and revocable mobile sessions

皮肤全家桶聚合插件：装它 = 皮肤中心（skin-center）+ 全部皮肤资产（qq98 / ths / xp / blue-fantasy / dragon-heir / minecraft / miku / trading 等，内置在包的 skins/ 目录，无需每皮肤独立 npm 包）。皮肤启用互斥由 dsh-skin use 管理（~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml managed 区段），因此皮肤只进 skins/ 资产、不进 patchFrom。

自动压缩（DSH Desktop 配套插件）：监听会话 contextPressure 投影，接近上下文上限（默认 80%，可调）时自动发送 /compact —— 默认开启，对话不再撑爆上下文
DeepSeek 账户余额 + 本轮会话费用估算（DSH Desktop 配套客户端插件，注册到对话统计栏 dock）

DSH Desktop built-in basics panel (upstream: yxsj245/dsh-Basics-Panel, MIT): a native Settings panel for visualizing and managing MCP servers, skills, rules and archived sessions with a modular feature registry. · DSH Desktop 内置基础能力面板：可视化并管理 MCP 服务器、技能、规则与归档会话（含空态「新建」入口）。

Better Sidebar for DSH — file tree, editor, changes, tasks and side chat in one column, separate for every conversation. Also exposes a service other plugins use to register sidebar tabs and file viewers.
AI 变更审核（DSH Desktop 配套插件）：监控会话的文件更改投影（fileChanges），手动或自动向当前对话发送审核请求，让 AI 复查自己刚做的改动（正确性 / 安全性 / 目标一致性），配合「文件」页的一键还原使用
DSH Desktop 配套会话体验：设置-通用里隐藏长篇对话输出 + 会话右侧导航滑轨

DSH Web内目前最无感的消息撤回、重编辑插件，原版体验，兼容性强，功能简单可开关，设置丰富，现代化轻量ui框架。The most seamless message recall & re-edit plugin for DSH Web — native experience, strong compatibility, simple toggles, rich settings, modern lightweight UI. DSH Web で最もシームレスなメッセージ撤回・再編集プラグイン——ネイティブ体験、高い互換性、シンプルなトグル、充実した設定、モダンで軽量な UI。
会话文件更改投影（fileChanges）：折叠 tool/result 的 meta.diffs，为「文件」视图与回退提供数据
会话用户提示词折叠（DSH Desktop 配套插件）：对用户发出去的超长提示词（user 消息）默认折叠为前几行 + 「展开」遮罩，点击展开全文、再点「收起」收回。仅当纯文本超过 400 字符或 8 行才折叠，短消息零侵入；不碰代码块/图片/表格，展开后原样（不丢内容、复制选中正常）。纯客户端，宿主半边 no-op。
终端式命令历史回溯（DSH Desktop 配套插件）：在会话输入框按 ↑ 回溯上一条已发送的用户消息、按 ↓ 往前翻回较新的消息，行为对齐终端命令行历史（空草稿才触发、越界回到空、编辑即复位、按会话隔离）。纯客户端，宿主半边 no-op。

Peak-hour price guard for DeepSeek API tidal pricing: intercept sends during peak hours (Beijing 09:00-12:00 / 14:00-18:00) and schedule them to run at off-peak prices. / DeepSeek 峰谷定价高峰拦截提醒：高峰时段拦截发送，定时到低价时段自动执行。
DSH plugin bridging WeChat / Feishu official channels into DSH agent sessions, with an IM bridge settings section in the DSH settings page (QQ provided by the official @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot)
把 DeepSeek Harness 装进你的口袋：一个包、一个设置页，手机扫码即同步访问电脑上的 DSH（局域网 + 公网，实时同屏）。
自定义 System Prompt：覆盖或追加 DeepSeek Harness 官方默认系统提示词（独立移植版，不依赖内核 settings API）
DSH 输入框 prompt 优化插件：一键把草稿润色为更清晰、更结构化的高质量 prompt。默认使用当前会话模型（零配置，SSE 流式 + 推理过程实时可见），也支持自配 OpenAI 兼容 API。
DSH Desktop 配套插件：Quest 模式界面（通用设置一键切换，默认关闭）

Codex-style DeepSeek Harness model and reasoning selector with model-advertised effort levels, DSH-native themes, left-clipped radiation effects, and copy-ready reasoning-effort declaration guidance for custom-provider models.
对话删除与归档管理（DSH Desktop 内置）：会话行菜单删除按钮 + 设置内「归档对话管理」面板（恢复/删除）。
设置页「常规」页内高级选项折叠（DSH Desktop 配套插件）：把低频使用的选项行（外观/语言/权限预设等，按行标题关键词识别）收进页面底部可折叠的「高级选项」组，默认收起，localStorage 持久化展开状态。纯客户端实现。
设置页左侧边栏自定义（DSH Desktop 配套插件）：设置面板底部「自定义边栏」——按需显示/隐藏与排序设置页左侧导航项（通用/模型/外观/插件/市场等 settings.section 条目），localStorage 持久化，默认全显零行为改变。纯客户端实现。
DSH 临时会话：独立悬浮窗，自动导入当前主对话上下文，发起不污染主会话的临时追问
DSH Desktop 内置子代理活动快视插件：为 Task/subagent 委派调用提供展开式活动视图（内联显示子代理执行过的命令与涉及的源码文件），并在会话头部聚合当前会话的命令/文件清单，明细全部来自客户端已有的会话事件流，零额外后端请求。
超级模组注入器：运行时注入任意本地 DSH 插件包（junction 链接 + loader.create，不碰 patch/package.json/不重启），热重载全家桶 + 开发侧挂区一键转正 + 一键卸载 + 路由自愈 + 插件管理 UI（设置页：列表/卸载/拖入内化），清单持久化重启自动恢复——DSH 生态的 BepInEx 式模组注入入口
A visual, non-linear conversation workspace plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

DSH Desktop workspace-anchor companion: injects a compact {{cwd}} preference block into the stable system prompt so agents default to the session workspace instead of drifting into unrelated directories. Prompt-level bias only; permissions are untouched.
zcode → dsh 会话迁移插件：把 zcode CLI 的历史会话转换成 dsh 原生会话日志，迁移后可在 dsh 里直接恢复

reviewSignals.disclaimer: Static triage signals only; not a security certification.

会话文件更改投影（fileChanges）：折叠 tool/result 的 meta.diffs，为「文件」视图与回退提供数据
会话用户提示词折叠（DSH Desktop 配套插件）：对用户发出去的超长提示词（user 消息）默认折叠为前几行 + 「展开」遮罩，点击展开全文、再点「收起」收回。仅当纯文本超过 400 字符或 8 行才折叠，短消息零侵入；不碰代码块/图片/表格，展开后原样（不丢内容、复制选中正常）。纯客户端，宿主半边 no-op。
终端式命令历史回溯（DSH Desktop 配套插件）：在会话输入框按 ↑ 回溯上一条已发送的用户消息、按 ↓ 往前翻回较新的消息，行为对齐终端命令行历史（空草稿才触发、越界回到空、编辑即复位、按会话隔离）。纯客户端，宿主半边 no-op。

把 DeepSeek Harness 装进你的口袋：一个包、一个设置页，手机扫码即同步访问电脑上的 DSH（局域网 + 公网，实时同屏）。
自定义 System Prompt：覆盖或追加 DeepSeek Harness 官方默认系统提示词（独立移植版，不依赖内核 settings API）

DSH Desktop 配套插件：Quest 模式界面（通用设置一键切换，默认关闭）

对话删除与归档管理（DSH Desktop 内置）：会话行菜单删除按钮 + 设置内「归档对话管理」面板（恢复/删除）。
设置页「常规」页内高级选项折叠（DSH Desktop 配套插件）：把低频使用的选项行（外观/语言/权限预设等，按行标题关键词识别）收进页面底部可折叠的「高级选项」组，默认收起，localStorage 持久化展开状态。纯客户端实现。
设置页左侧边栏自定义（DSH Desktop 配套插件）：设置面板底部「自定义边栏」——按需显示/隐藏与排序设置页左侧导航项（通用/模型/外观/插件/市场等 settings.section 条目），localStorage 持久化，默认全显零行为改变。纯客户端实现。
DSH 临时会话：独立悬浮窗，自动导入当前主对话上下文，发起不污染主会话的临时追问

超级模组注入器：运行时注入任意本地 DSH 插件包（junction 链接 + loader.create，不碰 patch/package.json/不重启），热重载全家桶 + 开发侧挂区一键转正 + 一键卸载 + 路由自愈 + 插件管理 UI（设置页：列表/卸载/拖入内化），清单持久化重启自动恢复——DSH 生态的 BepInEx 式模组注入入口
A visual, non-linear conversation workspace plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

DSH Desktop workspace-anchor companion: injects a compact {{cwd}} preference block into the stable system prompt so agents default to the session workspace instead of drifting into unrelated directories. Prompt-level bias only; permissions are untouched.
zcode → dsh 会话迁移插件：把 zcode CLI 的历史会话转换成 dsh 原生会话日志，迁移后可在 dsh 里直接恢复

终端式命令历史回溯（DSH Desktop 配套插件）：在会话输入框按 ↑ 回溯上一条已发送的用户消息、按 ↓ 往前翻回较新的消息，行为对齐终端命令行历史（空草稿才触发、越界回到空、编辑即复位、按会话隔离）。纯客户端，宿主半边 no-op。

DSH plugin bridging WeChat / Feishu official channels into DSH agent sessions, with an IM bridge settings section in the DSH settings page (QQ provided by the official @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot)
把 DeepSeek Harness 装进你的口袋：一个包、一个设置页，手机扫码即同步访问电脑上的 DSH（局域网 + 公网，实时同屏）。
自定义 System Prompt：覆盖或追加 DeepSeek Harness 官方默认系统提示词（独立移植版，不依赖内核 settings API）
DSH 输入框 prompt 优化插件：一键把草稿润色为更清晰、更结构化的高质量 prompt。默认使用当前会话模型（零配置，SSE 流式 + 推理过程实时可见），也支持自配 OpenAI 兼容 API。
DSH Desktop 配套插件：Quest 模式界面（通用设置一键切换，默认关闭）

Codex-style DeepSeek Harness model and reasoning selector with model-advertised effort levels, DSH-native themes, left-clipped radiation effects, and copy-ready reasoning-effort declaration guidance for custom-provider models.
对话删除与归档管理（DSH Desktop 内置）：会话行菜单删除按钮 + 设置内「归档对话管理」面板（恢复/删除）。
设置页「常规」页内高级选项折叠（DSH Desktop 配套插件）：把低频使用的选项行（外观/语言/权限预设等，按行标题关键词识别）收进页面底部可折叠的「高级选项」组，默认收起，localStorage 持久化展开状态。纯客户端实现。
设置页左侧边栏自定义（DSH Desktop 配套插件）：设置面板底部「自定义边栏」——按需显示/隐藏与排序设置页左侧导航项（通用/模型/外观/插件/市场等 settings.section 条目），localStorage 持久化，默认全显零行为改变。纯客户端实现。
DSH 临时会话：独立悬浮窗，自动导入当前主对话上下文，发起不污染主会话的临时追问

超级模组注入器：运行时注入任意本地 DSH 插件包（junction 链接 + loader.create，不碰 patch/package.json/不重启），热重载全家桶 + 开发侧挂区一键转正 + 一键卸载 + 路由自愈 + 插件管理 UI（设置页：列表/卸载/拖入内化），清单持久化重启自动恢复——DSH 生态的 BepInEx 式模组注入入口
A visual, non-linear conversation workspace plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

DSH Desktop workspace-anchor companion: injects a compact {{cwd}} preference block into the stable system prompt so agents default to the session workspace instead of drifting into unrelated directories. Prompt-level bias only; permissions are untouched.
zcode → dsh 会话迁移插件：把 zcode CLI 的历史会话转换成 dsh 原生会话日志，迁移后可在 dsh 里直接恢复

Better Sidebar for DSH — file tree, editor, changes, tasks and side chat in one column, separate for every conversation. Also exposes a service other plugins use to register sidebar tabs and file viewers.

DSH Web内目前最无感的消息撤回、重编辑插件，原版体验，兼容性强，功能简单可开关，设置丰富，现代化轻量ui框架。The most seamless message recall & re-edit plugin for DSH Web — native experience, strong compatibility, simple toggles, rich settings, modern lightweight UI. DSH Web で最もシームレスなメッセージ撤回・再編集プラグイン——ネイティブ体験、高い互換性、シンプルなトグル、充実した設定、モダンで軽量な UI。
会话文件更改投影（fileChanges）：折叠 tool/result 的 meta.diffs，为「文件」视图与回退提供数据
会话用户提示词折叠（DSH Desktop 配套插件）：对用户发出去的超长提示词（user 消息）默认折叠为前几行 + 「展开」遮罩，点击展开全文、再点「收起」收回。仅当纯文本超过 400 字符或 8 行才折叠，短消息零侵入；不碰代码块/图片/表格，展开后原样（不丢内容、复制选中正常）。纯客户端，宿主半边 no-op。
终端式命令历史回溯（DSH Desktop 配套插件）：在会话输入框按 ↑ 回溯上一条已发送的用户消息、按 ↓ 往前翻回较新的消息，行为对齐终端命令行历史（空草稿才触发、越界回到空、编辑即复位、按会话隔离）。纯客户端，宿主半边 no-op。

DSH plugin bridging WeChat / Feishu official channels into DSH agent sessions, with an IM bridge settings section in the DSH settings page (QQ provided by the official @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot)
把 DeepSeek Harness 装进你的口袋：一个包、一个设置页，手机扫码即同步访问电脑上的 DSH（局域网 + 公网，实时同屏）。
自定义 System Prompt：覆盖或追加 DeepSeek Harness 官方默认系统提示词（独立移植版，不依赖内核 settings API）
DSH 输入框 prompt 优化插件：一键把草稿润色为更清晰、更结构化的高质量 prompt。默认使用当前会话模型（零配置，SSE 流式 + 推理过程实时可见），也支持自配 OpenAI 兼容 API。
DSH Desktop 配套插件：Quest 模式界面（通用设置一键切换，默认关闭）

Codex-style DeepSeek Harness model and reasoning selector with model-advertised effort levels, DSH-native themes, left-clipped radiation effects, and copy-ready reasoning-effort declaration guidance for custom-provider models.
对话删除与归档管理（DSH Desktop 内置）：会话行菜单删除按钮 + 设置内「归档对话管理」面板（恢复/删除）。
设置页「常规」页内高级选项折叠（DSH Desktop 配套插件）：把低频使用的选项行（外观/语言/权限预设等，按行标题关键词识别）收进页面底部可折叠的「高级选项」组，默认收起，localStorage 持久化展开状态。纯客户端实现。
设置页左侧边栏自定义（DSH Desktop 配套插件）：设置面板底部「自定义边栏」——按需显示/隐藏与排序设置页左侧导航项（通用/模型/外观/插件/市场等 settings.section 条目），localStorage 持久化，默认全显零行为改变。纯客户端实现。
DSH 临时会话：独立悬浮窗，自动导入当前主对话上下文，发起不污染主会话的临时追问
DSH Desktop 内置子代理活动快视插件：为 Task/subagent 委派调用提供展开式活动视图（内联显示子代理执行过的命令与涉及的源码文件），并在会话头部聚合当前会话的命令/文件清单，明细全部来自客户端已有的会话事件流，零额外后端请求。
超级模组注入器：运行时注入任意本地 DSH 插件包（junction 链接 + loader.create，不碰 patch/package.json/不重启），热重载全家桶 + 开发侧挂区一键转正 + 一键卸载 + 路由自愈 + 插件管理 UI（设置页：列表/卸载/拖入内化），清单持久化重启自动恢复——DSH 生态的 BepInEx 式模组注入入口

manifests.description: DSH redteam security research modes and runtime plugins, managed from one settings page: deploy the nine presets, install, update and uninstall the seventeen runtime plugins for the current profile.

AttackAtlas tab for the eight specialist security presets: per-mode architecture matrix (battle zones x tactics x items with per-mode terminal-state semantics), four-state coverage light-up, dispatch-on-double-click, attack-chain topology, custom work-methodology composer (layered run envelope, closure inquiry), tool/MCP/custom-tool modules with install-approval protocol, and a capability library of user-defined categories and items shared into the composer. v1.2.0 made the target a first-class dimension of the coverage ledger: coverage cells, stage bands and chain topology are accounted per target (same cell keeps independent terminal states per target), with an active-target pointer (first registered target auto-activates; redteam_atlas_target switch re-anchors; writes default to the active target), a per-target/aggregate matrix view, and org (organization) as a target kind. v1.2.1 selects the working target from a dropdown (selecting re-anchors and routes dispatches/default writes to it; a persistent badge shows the active anchor), and adds the LLM output-downstream-parsing cell (jailbreak only becomes a traditional vuln when the server re-parses model output into deserialization/SSTI/command sinks; pure-text-model targets have no such bridge). Legacy stores migrate automatically (single-target sessions attributed, multi-target rows kept in the session-common scope; *_legacy tables retained).

Auto-advancer for the eight professional security presets: when a subagent-class executor returns and the intent ledger still has open directions, a followup nudge is injected carrying the ledger state — close the intent (done with output pointer / blocked with reason), then anchor-dispatch the next step or finish quietly. Guardrailed autonomy: consecutive-turn cap (human input resets), opt-in via the intent ledger (open intents required), self-describing nudges, and a cooldown window that coalesces parallel returns. Injects only — never intercepts or rewrites; non-professional or ledger-less sessions are untouched. v0.2.0 kickoff nudge: the first human message in a professional-mode session with no operation-state draws a one-time three-registration reminder (goal/constraints/scope) — no hard gate, quick tasks may ignore. v0.3.0 mode-aware kickoff: the first-registration reminder now carries the session mode's decomposition theory, criteria structure, scope semantics and constraint hints (DECOMPOSITION imported from the sibling stage-gate plugin with generic-text degrade).

Campaign memory for the nine security presets: model-side write/search/get/list/remove tools storing raw content verbatim (credentials may be stored as-is or as pointers to existing local vaults), a marker-tagged per-workspace recall block injected into every assembly (fresh workspace starts clean; cross-workspace recall is an explicit search with provenance labels), preview-capped retrieval with on-demand full-text fetch, usage-ranked with expiry for detection fingerprints, a loopback web channel, and a per-session tab for browsing, searching and curating memories.

DSH hunter plugin: FOFA / Hunter(qianxin) / Quake(360) aggregated asset search with unified DSL → per-platform syntax conversion, quota-aware pagination/export, API-key settings panel, and the code-audit live-verification pipeline (L0 fingerprint check on internet assets, L1 minimal-impact EXP only on user-authorized assets).

MCP server studio for DeepSeek Harness: live-mounted servers with real connection status, a per-server tool browser, JSON import, and a dashboard-grade settings page. v1.0.3 adds the sse transport: JSON import keeps a declared sse type, diagnose speaks the streamable SSE legacy protocol (endpoint event + POST message URL, CRLF-normalized frames), and host mounting runs a bundled stdio<->sse bridge process so servers like yak-mcp work without host-side sse support.

DSH web client plugin: two-tier agent-preset picker on the new-session screen — built-ins and the researcher entry stay top-level while the eight professional security modes fold into a hover/click submenu, viewport-adaptive, with no other surface touched. v1.0.1 dual-host adaptation: the preset read/write surface is resolved at runtime (remote.agentPresets on hosts 0.1.2+, the legacy connection.api surface on older hosts) instead of a hard inject, so older hosts no longer stall web boot with a pending entry; when neither surface exists the plugin deactivates transparently and keeps the native picker.

DSH subagent providers for the local claude-code / codex CLIs: registers the host-plane 'claude-code' and 'codex' providers the nine security presets' tool rows name. The CLIs keep their own model backend config (~/.claude/settings.json env, ~/.codex/config.toml); this plugin only spawns them headless and maps exit to a subagent run.

Session-scoped redteam findings registry for the nine security presets: model-side register/update/delete tools, a self-registered loopback web channel, and a per-session conversation tab (redteam 成果) with per-mode pages across all nine modes (board style per mode: findings / assets / ledger / timeline / cloudpath) plus a cross-session global ledger overview, severity stats, type distribution, lifecycle status, pagination, verify-to-session and MD/HTML exports.

DSH host-plane refusal-repair proximity injection for the five security presets: watches assistant turn text on session/event, detects refusal/moralizing patterns (two-tier: strong phrases full-text + weak keywords head-150, ), and when a hit lands re-injects a one-shot authorized-context reminder as a dynamic systemPrompt context contribution. RuntimeContextProjection dedupes: the reminder lands only when it appears (text change) and disappears after the repaired turn (change back to empty) — steady state costs nothing. Non-security presets resolve no preset id and render nothing.

DSH host-plane route booster for the nine security presets: infers the current (mode, phase) from the latest user message (sticky phase memory) and re-injects a compact governance envelope — gate checklist (from dsh-stage-gate GATES), review/double-sign reminder, boundary line, evidence-level pre-judgment, refs pointers or a forced-search nudge on miss — as a dynamic systemPrompt context contribution. A new snapshot lands only when the envelope text CHANGES (RuntimeContextProjection dedupes), so steady phases cost nothing. v1.1.0 renders the constraint red-line line in the operation envelope whenever constraints are registered (compaction-proof visibility of user-stated deny/allow). v1.2.0 phase surface: in a wrap-up phase (report/summary/review) dispatch-class tools (subagent family + workflow) are folded away by a guard reading the sticky phase — closing takes priority over opening new directions; the envelope states the fold. v1.3.1 pins the target-side zero-destruction red line as a fixed top-of-envelope line for every enveloped mode (trim-safe: tail drops cannot reach it).

DSH host-plane deterministic enforcement for the nine security presets : ctx.tools.guard() pre-execute interception — report files require a stage_gate PASS in gate-log.md, writes stay inside the task workspace (least privilege), conservative high-risk bash patterns must go through the ask-first flow, and bare full-port scans without rate controls are rejected with the fix. Guards fire only for the nine security presets; every denial appends to the workspace enforce-log.md. v1.1.0 adds the ask tier: reversible-but-invasive classes (account/privilege changes, firewall rule edits, flood stress) route through the tools/pre-execute waterfall into the host approval service (allowed-once or deny) instead of a hard block. v1.2.0: open intents block report writes until closed (intentGate, default on); the redteam controller's task briefs (task-briefs/*.md) must carry a 依据/锚点 line naming what justified opening the brief. v1.3.0 constraintGate: keyword-bearing deny constraints from the task ledger intercept matching bash commands and fetch URLs, citing the constraint text; prompt-only constraints stay envelope-injected. v1.4.2 target-side zero-destruction tier: Windows deletion family (Remove-Item -Recurse / rd /s / del /s against drive roots or system dirs, matching the rm-root scope) and format/erase commands (format X:, mkfs) are deterministically blocked, with denial texts citing the target-side zero-destruction clause.

Session status panel for the nine security presets: header progress chip (task-list projection with completion bar), subagent chip with a right-side subagent directory drawer (running/finished groups, click a name to open that subagent session), and a left-center prompt rail listing user prompts with hover preview and click-to-locate on the chat anchor.

DSH stage-gate host plugin: the stage_gate / gates_list model tools validate task-workspace artifacts against the nine security presets' gate schemas (structural checks, v1), append verdicts to gate-log.md, and list each mode's canonical gate files v1.2.0 adds the intent ledger: operation_intent registers a direction with a mandatory evidence anchor (boot exemption / criterion / scope / current-session finding / chain node — cross-store validators with format-check degrade), operation_progress closes intents (done/blocked/dropped, reason required for terminal states). v1.3.0 adds the constraints layer (operation_constraints: deny/allow with optional match keywords — keyword-bearing deny entries feed deterministic bash/fetch interception) and conservative scope auto-derivation (operation_goal returns a host-precise scope draft extracted from goal/criteria text, model confirms before registering). v1.4.0 mode-aware decomposition: DECOMPOSITION per-mode theory injected into operation_goal/scope/constraints renders (session mode resolved at execute time), and deriveScopeDraft grows per-mode extractors (audit file/route paths, binary sample hashes, cloud account/region/ARN, ad CIDR; av/ctf/redteam registration-only).

Process vault for the nine security presets: zero-touch capture of every tool call (tool/call + tool/result paired by callId) into a local SQLite store with outcome classification (ok / blocked / error), plus model-side trace_search / trace_get / trace_recent tools — cross-compaction process memory and the failure-attribution data plane. Security-mode sessions only; capture never intercepts or rewrites; stored text is capped (index, not archive). Adds the failure-attribution envelope: a systemPrompt context block renders a blocked-aggregation hint (403/WAF/429 cluster) per assembly, change-only delivery, security modes only. v0.2.1: result text extraction handles the real pipeline nested tool-result blocks (text lives in the inner content array), found by live-model probing.

DSH webshell manager host plugin: session tab beside hunter with connection registry and protocol auto-detect (self-developed AES opcode channel, one-liner cmd/eval, modified-manager variants, stock manager compat), command exec / virtual terminal, file manager (binary-safe transfer, chmod, timestamp forge, remote fetch), database console (PDO native over eval-capable shells, CLI fallback), shell generator, declarative payload-plugin system discoverable by sessions, model tools for the five security presets, and a stdio MCP server sharing the same core.

plugins.description: Auto-advancer for the eight professional security presets: when a subagent-class executor returns and the intent ledger still has open directions, a followup nudge is injected carrying the ledger state — close the intent (done with output pointer / blocked with reason), then anchor-dispatch the next step or finish quietly. Guardrailed autonomy: consecutive-turn cap (human input resets), opt-in via the intent ledger (open intents required), self-describing nudges, and a cooldown window that coalesces parallel returns. Injects only — never intercepts or rewrites; non-professional or ledger-less sessions are untouched. v0.2.0 kickoff nudge: the first human message in a professional-mode session with no operation-state draws a one-time three-registration reminder (goal/constraints/scope) — no hard gate, quick tasks may ignore. v0.3.0 mode-aware kickoff: the first-registration reminder now carries the session mode's decomposition theory, criteria structure, scope semantics and constraint hints (DECOMPOSITION imported from the sibling stage-gate plugin with generic-text degrade).

manifests.description: DSH redteam security research modes and runtime plugins, managed from one settings page: deploy the nine presets, install, update and uninstall the seventeen runtime plugins for the current profile.

AttackAtlas tab for the eight specialist security presets: per-mode architecture matrix (battle zones x tactics x items with per-mode terminal-state semantics), four-state coverage light-up, dispatch-on-double-click, attack-chain topology, custom work-methodology composer (layered run envelope, closure inquiry), tool/MCP/custom-tool modules with install-approval protocol, and a capability library of user-defined categories and items shared into the composer. v1.2.0 made the target a first-class dimension of the coverage ledger: coverage cells, stage bands and chain topology are accounted per target (same cell keeps independent terminal states per target), with an active-target pointer (first registered target auto-activates; redteam_atlas_target switch re-anchors; writes default to the active target), a per-target/aggregate matrix view, and org (organization) as a target kind. v1.2.1 selects the working target from a dropdown (selecting re-anchors and routes dispatches/default writes to it; a persistent badge shows the active anchor), and adds the LLM output-downstream-parsing cell (jailbreak only becomes a traditional vuln when the server re-parses model output into deserialization/SSTI/command sinks; pure-text-model targets have no such bridge). Legacy stores migrate automatically (single-target sessions attributed, multi-target rows kept in the session-common scope; *_legacy tables retained).

Auto-advancer for the eight professional security presets: when a subagent-class executor returns and the intent ledger still has open directions, a followup nudge is injected carrying the ledger state — close the intent (done with output pointer / blocked with reason), then anchor-dispatch the next step or finish quietly. Guardrailed autonomy: consecutive-turn cap (human input resets), opt-in via the intent ledger (open intents required), self-describing nudges, and a cooldown window that coalesces parallel returns. Injects only — never intercepts or rewrites; non-professional or ledger-less sessions are untouched. v0.2.0 kickoff nudge: the first human message in a professional-mode session with no operation-state draws a one-time three-registration reminder (goal/constraints/scope) — no hard gate, quick tasks may ignore. v0.3.0 mode-aware kickoff: the first-registration reminder now carries the session mode's decomposition theory, criteria structure, scope semantics and constraint hints (DECOMPOSITION imported from the sibling stage-gate plugin with generic-text degrade).

Campaign memory for the nine security presets: model-side write/search/get/list/remove tools storing raw content verbatim (credentials may be stored as-is or as pointers to existing local vaults), a marker-tagged per-workspace recall block injected into every assembly (fresh workspace starts clean; cross-workspace recall is an explicit search with provenance labels), preview-capped retrieval with on-demand full-text fetch, usage-ranked with expiry for detection fingerprints, a loopback web channel, and a per-session tab for browsing, searching and curating memories.

DSH hunter plugin: FOFA / Hunter(qianxin) / Quake(360) aggregated asset search with unified DSL → per-platform syntax conversion, quota-aware pagination/export, API-key settings panel, and the code-audit live-verification pipeline (L0 fingerprint check on internet assets, L1 minimal-impact EXP only on user-authorized assets).

MCP server studio for DeepSeek Harness: live-mounted servers with real connection status, a per-server tool browser, JSON import, and a dashboard-grade settings page. v1.0.3 adds the sse transport: JSON import keeps a declared sse type, diagnose speaks the streamable SSE legacy protocol (endpoint event + POST message URL, CRLF-normalized frames), and host mounting runs a bundled stdio<->sse bridge process so servers like yak-mcp work without host-side sse support.

DSH web client plugin: two-tier agent-preset picker on the new-session screen — built-ins and the researcher entry stay top-level while the eight professional security modes fold into a hover/click submenu, viewport-adaptive, with no other surface touched. v1.0.1 dual-host adaptation: the preset read/write surface is resolved at runtime (remote.agentPresets on hosts 0.1.2+, the legacy connection.api surface on older hosts) instead of a hard inject, so older hosts no longer stall web boot with a pending entry; when neither surface exists the plugin deactivates transparently and keeps the native picker.

DSH subagent providers for the local claude-code / codex CLIs: registers the host-plane 'claude-code' and 'codex' providers the nine security presets' tool rows name. The CLIs keep their own model backend config (~/.claude/settings.json env, ~/.codex/config.toml); this plugin only spawns them headless and maps exit to a subagent run.

Session-scoped redteam findings registry for the nine security presets: model-side register/update/delete tools, a self-registered loopback web channel, and a per-session conversation tab (redteam 成果) with per-mode pages across all nine modes (board style per mode: findings / assets / ledger / timeline / cloudpath) plus a cross-session global ledger overview, severity stats, type distribution, lifecycle status, pagination, verify-to-session and MD/HTML exports.

DSH host-plane refusal-repair proximity injection for the five security presets: watches assistant turn text on session/event, detects refusal/moralizing patterns (two-tier: strong phrases full-text + weak keywords head-150, ), and when a hit lands re-injects a one-shot authorized-context reminder as a dynamic systemPrompt context contribution. RuntimeContextProjection dedupes: the reminder lands only when it appears (text change) and disappears after the repaired turn (change back to empty) — steady state costs nothing. Non-security presets resolve no preset id and render nothing.

DSH host-plane route booster for the nine security presets: infers the current (mode, phase) from the latest user message (sticky phase memory) and re-injects a compact governance envelope — gate checklist (from dsh-stage-gate GATES), review/double-sign reminder, boundary line, evidence-level pre-judgment, refs pointers or a forced-search nudge on miss — as a dynamic systemPrompt context contribution. A new snapshot lands only when the envelope text CHANGES (RuntimeContextProjection dedupes), so steady phases cost nothing. v1.1.0 renders the constraint red-line line in the operation envelope whenever constraints are registered (compaction-proof visibility of user-stated deny/allow). v1.2.0 phase surface: in a wrap-up phase (report/summary/review) dispatch-class tools (subagent family + workflow) are folded away by a guard reading the sticky phase — closing takes priority over opening new directions; the envelope states the fold. v1.3.1 pins the target-side zero-destruction red line as a fixed top-of-envelope line for every enveloped mode (trim-safe: tail drops cannot reach it).

DSH host-plane deterministic enforcement for the nine security presets : ctx.tools.guard() pre-execute interception — report files require a stage_gate PASS in gate-log.md, writes stay inside the task workspace (least privilege), conservative high-risk bash patterns must go through the ask-first flow, and bare full-port scans without rate controls are rejected with the fix. Guards fire only for the nine security presets; every denial appends to the workspace enforce-log.md. v1.1.0 adds the ask tier: reversible-but-invasive classes (account/privilege changes, firewall rule edits, flood stress) route through the tools/pre-execute waterfall into the host approval service (allowed-once or deny) instead of a hard block. v1.2.0: open intents block report writes until closed (intentGate, default on); the redteam controller's task briefs (task-briefs/*.md) must carry a 依据/锚点 line naming what justified opening the brief. v1.3.0 constraintGate: keyword-bearing deny constraints from the task ledger intercept matching bash commands and fetch URLs, citing the constraint text; prompt-only constraints stay envelope-injected. v1.4.2 target-side zero-destruction tier: Windows deletion family (Remove-Item -Recurse / rd /s / del /s against drive roots or system dirs, matching the rm-root scope) and format/erase commands (format X:, mkfs) are deterministically blocked, with denial texts citing the target-side zero-destruction clause.

Session status panel for the nine security presets: header progress chip (task-list projection with completion bar), subagent chip with a right-side subagent directory drawer (running/finished groups, click a name to open that subagent session), and a left-center prompt rail listing user prompts with hover preview and click-to-locate on the chat anchor.

DSH stage-gate host plugin: the stage_gate / gates_list model tools validate task-workspace artifacts against the nine security presets' gate schemas (structural checks, v1), append verdicts to gate-log.md, and list each mode's canonical gate files v1.2.0 adds the intent ledger: operation_intent registers a direction with a mandatory evidence anchor (boot exemption / criterion / scope / current-session finding / chain node — cross-store validators with format-check degrade), operation_progress closes intents (done/blocked/dropped, reason required for terminal states). v1.3.0 adds the constraints layer (operation_constraints: deny/allow with optional match keywords — keyword-bearing deny entries feed deterministic bash/fetch interception) and conservative scope auto-derivation (operation_goal returns a host-precise scope draft extracted from goal/criteria text, model confirms before registering). v1.4.0 mode-aware decomposition: DECOMPOSITION per-mode theory injected into operation_goal/scope/constraints renders (session mode resolved at execute time), and deriveScopeDraft grows per-mode extractors (audit file/route paths, binary sample hashes, cloud account/region/ARN, ad CIDR; av/ctf/redteam registration-only).

Process vault for the nine security presets: zero-touch capture of every tool call (tool/call + tool/result paired by callId) into a local SQLite store with outcome classification (ok / blocked / error), plus model-side trace_search / trace_get / trace_recent tools — cross-compaction process memory and the failure-attribution data plane. Security-mode sessions only; capture never intercepts or rewrites; stored text is capped (index, not archive). Adds the failure-attribution envelope: a systemPrompt context block renders a blocked-aggregation hint (403/WAF/429 cluster) per assembly, change-only delivery, security modes only. v0.2.1: result text extraction handles the real pipeline nested tool-result blocks (text lives in the inner content array), found by live-model probing.

DSH webshell manager host plugin: session tab beside hunter with connection registry and protocol auto-detect (self-developed AES opcode channel, one-liner cmd/eval, modified-manager variants, stock manager compat), command exec / virtual terminal, file manager (binary-safe transfer, chmod, timestamp forge, remote fetch), database console (PDO native over eval-capable shells, CLI fallback), shell generator, declarative payload-plugin system discoverable by sessions, model tools for the five security presets, and a stdio MCP server sharing the same core.

A new snapshot lands only when the envelope text CHANGES (RuntimeContextProjection dedupes), so steady phases cost nothing. v1.1.0 renders the constraint red-line line in the operation envelope whenever constraints are registered (compaction-proof visibility of user-stated deny/allow). v1.2.0 phase surface: in a wrap-up phase (report/summary/review) dispatch-class tools (subagent family + workflow) are folded away by a guard reading the sticky phase — closing takes priority over opening new directions; the envelope states the fold. v1.3.1 pins the target-side zero-destruction red line as a fixed top-of-envelope line for every enveloped mode (trim-safe: tail drops cannot reach it).

manifests.description: DSH redteam security research modes and runtime plugins, managed from one settings page: deploy the nine presets, install, update and uninstall the seventeen runtime plugins for the current profile.

AttackAtlas tab for the eight specialist security presets: per-mode architecture matrix (battle zones x tactics x items with per-mode terminal-state semantics), four-state coverage light-up, dispatch-on-double-click, attack-chain topology, custom work-methodology composer (layered run envelope, closure inquiry), tool/MCP/custom-tool modules with install-approval protocol, and a capability library of user-defined categories and items shared into the composer. v1.2.0 made the target a first-class dimension of the coverage ledger: coverage cells, stage bands and chain topology are accounted per target (same cell keeps independent terminal states per target), with an active-target pointer (first registered target auto-activates; redteam_atlas_target switch re-anchors; writes default to the active target), a per-target/aggregate matrix view, and org (organization) as a target kind. v1.2.1 selects the working target from a dropdown (selecting re-anchors and routes dispatches/default writes to it; a persistent badge shows the active anchor), and adds the LLM output-downstream-parsing cell (jailbreak only becomes a traditional vuln when the server re-parses model output into deserialization/SSTI/command sinks; pure-text-model targets have no such bridge). Auto-advancer for the eight professional security presets: when a subagent-class executor returns and the intent ledger still has open directions, a followup nudge is injected carrying the ledger state — close the intent (done with output pointer / blocked with reason), then anchor-dispatch the next step or finish quietly. Campaign memory for the nine security presets: model-side write/search/get/list/remove tools storing raw content verbatim (credentials may be stored as-is or as pointers to existing local vaults), a marker-tagged per-workspace recall block injected into every assembly (fresh workspace starts clean; cross-workspace recall is an explicit search with provenance labels), preview-capped retrieval with on-demand full-text fetch, usage-ranked with expiry for detection fingerprints, a loopback web channel, and a per-session tab for browsing, searching and curating memories.

DSH hunter plugin: FOFA / Hunter(qianxin) / Quake(360) aggregated asset search with unified DSL → per-platform syntax conversion, quota-aware pagination/export, API-key settings panel, and the code-audit live-verification pipeline (L0 fingerprint check on internet assets, L1 minimal-impact EXP only on user-authorized assets).

MCP server studio for DeepSeek Harness: live-mounted servers with real connection status, a per-server tool browser, JSON import, and a dashboard-grade settings page. v1.0.3 adds the sse transport: JSON import keeps a declared sse type, diagnose speaks the streamable SSE legacy protocol (endpoint event + POST message URL, CRLF-normalized frames), and host mounting runs a bundled stdio<->sse bridge process so servers like yak-mcp work without host-side sse support.

A new snapshot lands only when the envelope text CHANGES (RuntimeContextProjection dedupes), so steady phases cost nothing. v1.1.0 renders the constraint red-line line in the operation envelope whenever constraints are registered (compaction-proof visibility of user-stated deny/allow). v1.2.0 phase surface: in a wrap-up phase (report/summary/review) dispatch-class tools (subagent family + workflow) are folded away by a guard reading the sticky phase — closing takes priority over opening new directions; the envelope states the fold. v1.3.1 pins the target-side zero-destruction red line as a fixed top-of-envelope line for every enveloped mode (trim-safe: tail drops cannot reach it).

DSH host-plane deterministic enforcement for the nine security presets : ctx.tools.guard() pre-execute interception — report files require a stage_gate PASS in gate-log.md, writes stay inside the task workspace (least privilege), conservative high-risk bash patterns must go through the ask-first flow, and bare full-port scans without rate controls are rejected with the fix. Guards fire only for the nine security presets; every denial appends to the workspace enforce-log.md. v1.1.0 adds the ask tier: reversible-but-invasive classes (account/privilege changes, firewall rule edits, flood stress) route through the tools/pre-execute waterfall into the host approval service (allowed-once or deny) instead of a hard block. v1.2.0: open intents block report writes until closed (intentGate, default on); the redteam controller's task briefs (task-briefs/*.md) must carry a 依据/锚点 line naming what justified opening the brief. v1.3.0 constraintGate: keyword-bearing deny constraints from the task ledger intercept matching bash commands and fetch URLs, citing the constraint text; prompt-only constraints stay envelope-injected. v1.4.2 target-side zero-destruction tier: Windows deletion family (Remove-Item -Recurse / rd /s / del /s against drive roots or system dirs, matching the rm-root scope) and format/erase commands (format X:, mkfs) are deterministically blocked, with denial texts citing the target-side zero-destruction clause.

Session status panel for the nine security presets: header progress chip (task-list projection with completion bar), subagent chip with a right-side subagent directory drawer (running/finished groups, click a name to open that subagent session), and a left-center prompt rail listing user prompts with hover preview and click-to-locate on the chat anchor.

DSH stage-gate host plugin: the stage_gate / gates_list model tools validate task-workspace artifacts against the nine security presets' gate schemas (structural checks, v1), append verdicts to gate-log.md, and list each mode's canonical gate files v1.2.0 adds the intent ledger: operation_intent registers a direction with a mandatory evidence anchor (boot exemption / criterion / scope / current-session finding / chain node — cross-store validators with format-check degrade), operation_progress closes intents (done/blocked/dropped, reason required for terminal states). v1.3.0 adds the constraints layer (operation_constraints: deny/allow with optional match keywords — keyword-bearing deny entries feed deterministic bash/fetch interception) and conservative scope auto-derivation (operation_goal returns a host-precise scope draft extracted from goal/criteria text, model confirms before registering). v1.4.0 mode-aware decomposition: DECOMPOSITION per-mode theory injected into operation_goal/scope/constraints renders (session mode resolved at execute time), and deriveScopeDraft grows per-mode extractors (audit file/route paths, binary sample hashes, cloud account/region/ARN, ad CIDR; av/ctf/redteam registration-only).

Process vault for the nine security presets: zero-touch capture of every tool call (tool/call + tool/result paired by callId) into a local SQLite store with outcome classification (ok / blocked / error), plus model-side trace_search / trace_get / trace_recent tools — cross-compaction process memory and the failure-attribution data plane. Security-mode sessions only; capture never intercepts or rewrites; stored text is capped (index, not archive). Adds the failure-attribution envelope: a systemPrompt context block renders a blocked-aggregation hint (403/WAF/429 cluster) per assembly, change-only delivery, security modes only. v0.2.1: result text extraction handles the real pipeline nested tool-result blocks (text lives in the inner content array), found by live-model probing.

DSH webshell manager host plugin: session tab beside hunter with connection registry and protocol auto-detect (self-developed AES opcode channel, one-liner cmd/eval, modified-manager variants, stock manager compat), command exec / virtual terminal, file manager (binary-safe transfer, chmod, timestamp forge, remote fetch), database console (PDO native over eval-capable shells, CLI fallback), shell generator, declarative payload-plugin system discoverable by sessions, model tools for the five security presets, and a stdio MCP server sharing the same core.

plugins.name: acryl-desktop
plugins.description: ACRYL desktop: a local-first agent workspace composed with Cordis plugins

manifests.description: ACRYL desktop: a local-first agent workspace composed with Cordis plugins
To-do list, calendar and meeting booking grown from the Blank Blueprint: the reference for what a Blend adds

Agent Control (spec 041): a governed, snapshot-and-act interface to ACRYL's own window for the agent, one Cordis plugin for Web and Desktop. Host tools reach the page over a same-origin WebSocket; the in-page driver builds accessibility snapshots with short-lived refs, redacts sensitive fields, refuses protected controls, and shows an "agent is driving" indicator with a kill switch
Save an ACRYL app to its own git repository from inside the app (/app save, /app connect): the secret check and the private-to-public guard, through the user's own git and gh

The generic three-column desktop/web app frame (brand sidebar, main surface, resizable details column, theme, platform title-bar spacing) any ACRYL Blend's domain plugin claims as its own main UI, the same way plugins/acryl-workspace claims it for the IDE. Extracted from acryl-workspace's own shell/ so the next Blueprint after the IDE does not rebuild this wiring again.
Consumer of the speller capability
Provider A of the speller capability
Provider B of the speller capability
Registers a /hello-example chat slash command (all surfaces)
Adds a Bookmark action under every finished assistant message (conversation.chat.assistant-actions slot)
Adds a top-bar button that opens a notes panel (web client plugin, no build step)
Adds a tab to the right sidebar (web client plugin, no build step)
Restyles the Web and Desktop app: brand color, accent, and font via the theme service (no build step)
A tool plus a custom card that renders its calls in the conversation (tool.call.toolview slot)
Quick-notes launcher built from the shared UI primitives (Button, Modal, Input, Switch, Tag) in the sidebar footer
Gallery of the ACRYL UI library (@acryl/ui) as a page in Settings: every component, the color roles, and a Settings-style form
Adds a Whiteboard tab type to the workspace (web client plugin, no build step)
Typed, validated plugin config (Schemastery)
Reads the desktopProfiles Host service (full on Desktop, a subset on Web and CLI)
Listens to and emits a Cordis event
Template for an agent-generated capability package (constitution V)
Adds an HTTP route to the web host
Smallest ACRYL plugin: a lifecycle function that logs once when it mounts

DSH Web GUI 的 Codegraph 集成插件：提供 Codegraph 状态、符号搜索、callers/callees/impact 查看与一键 sync/index，托管 codegraph MCP 服务器项目目录并向 agent 注入能力提示；表单内联在插件详情页「说明」下方（设置 → 插件配置 页里也有同一份）。
DSH Web GUI 的 Docker 容器面板插件：本机或 SSH 主机上的容器列表 / 启停删 / 日志 / 统计 / 镜像 / 一次性 exec，默认只读，配套只读优先的 agent 工具。
DSH Web GUI 的环境变量 / 密钥管理插件：托管 ~/.dsh/env.yml 的密钥区块，支持普通值与 js: 前缀表达式，保存后可选写入当前进程环境变量；表单内联在插件详情页「说明」下方（设置 → 插件配置 页里也有同一份）。
DSH Web GUI 的 kit 插件配置入口：在官方「设置」里补一行与「通用设置」平级的「插件配置」页，把 dsh-plugin-kit 各插件的配置表单收在一处。
DSH Web GUI 的 MCP 服务器配置插件：托管 ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml 的 MCP 区块，支持 stdio / streamable-http、连接测试与启用停用，保存后经 HMR 热加载为 mcp__<server>__<tool> 工具；表单内联在插件详情页「说明」下方（设置 → 插件配置 页里也有同一份）。
DSH Web GUI 的 Profile 管理插件：可视化查看 / 创建 / 复制 / 删除 DSH profiles，管理 ~/.dsh/profiles 下的 profile 目录；表单内联在插件详情页「说明」下方（设置 → 插件配置 页里也有同一份）。
DSH Web GUI 的 Prompt 管理插件：可视化编辑 systemPrompt，带版本管理与 A/B 分流，可导出 / 导入 / 复制分享，配置存于 ~/.dsh/prompts.yml 的托管区块。
DSH Web GUI 的 RSS / 新闻聚合插件：订阅多个 RSS/Atom 源，每天自动汇总一篇「今日值得读」并注入 systemPrompt 供模型直接引用。
DSH Web GUI 的全局搜索插件：侧边栏「全局搜索」（⌘/Ctrl + K）命令面板式一处检索历史会话、Prompt、MCP 工具与设置面板。
DSH Web GUI 的终端面板插件：侧边栏「终端」提供 xterm.js + PTY 全交互终端与 ssh2 原生 SSH 远程连接（连接簿、主机指纹 TOFU、跳板机），支持 tmux 会话持久化、SFTP 文件传输、端口转发与服务器状态条，并向其他插件开放 ttyTerminal / ttyPanel / ttyConnbar 扩展点；Windows 宿主同样可用。
dsh-plugin-kit 的最小 host 插件模板：dsh manifest、bundle patch 与构建配置的参考实现，也是 pnpm create-plugin 的复制蓝本。

reviewSignals.disclaimer: Static triage signals only; not a security certification.

manifests.description: Decision gateway for DSH agents: calibrated Choice/Score/Noul verdicts via ws_request_verdict + local secret precheck + dual-track keys. 通用辅助决策网关（JEV 为首个 provider）：frozen 预设模板 + 密钥双轨（ENV 引用优先）+ 本地密形预检 + SystemOne 官方调用，工具 ws_request_verdict / ws_list_verdict_guides

Expose the dsh web UI on the LAN by forwarding HTTP/HTTPS and WebSocket to the loopback server. 局域网访问 dsh web UI：在 0.0.0.0:<port> 监听，把 HTTP/HTTPS 与 WebSocket/wss 转发到回环 web 服务器（默认 127.0.0.1:3080）。重写 Host/Origin 以通过 /api 浏览器信任围栏，仅接受 IP 字面量或 localhost 的 Host 头（DNS 重绑定防护）。HTTPS 默认并存（3443），证书可配置或自动生成自签名。

Manage MCP servers (stdio / streamable-http) for dsh web; tools are reached only through four middleware tools. DSH MCP 管理器：Web 侧边栏「MCP」入口，面板按状态分级展示 MCP 服务器（运行中/连接中/已配置/失败），支持快速接入（stdio / streamable-http 表单）与粘贴 mcpServers JSON 导入。已连接服务器的工具一律经中间层工具（ws_mcp_search / ws_mcp_detail / ws_mcp_call / ws_mcp_list）访问：宿主注册名 mcp__<id>__<tool> 是内部标识（id 按 (工作空间, 服务器名) 分配、不可由服务器名推导），不对模型可见，禁止直呼。

Task-event notifications for dsh web via browser Notification and host system toast. 审批/完成/错误事件通知：浏览器 Notification + 系统原生 toast（Windows PowerShell WinRT / macOS osascript / Linux notify-send，均无需额外安装）；提示音可配、每条通知独立显示不互相替换、非安全上下文自动降级横幅

Meta-package installing all dsh-plugin-hub plugins at once: notifier, provider-usage, mcp-manager, lan-proxy, verify-isolated and worktree-sidebar. DSH 插件全家桶聚合包：一键安装全部功能插件（notifier / provider-usage / mcp-manager / lan-proxy / verify-isolated / worktree-sidebar）。装它 = 子包 dependencies 拉齐 + 聚合 cordis patch 激活。dsh-gzip / dsh-web-file-preview 等已退役包不再随全家桶分发。

Multi-provider usage stats for dsh web: floating capsule plus detail panel, fed by drop-in mjs adapters. 用量统计悬浮框（v2 契约）：胶囊 + 详情面板，宿主端渲染 HTML 注入；用户 mjs 适配器三函数接入任意数据源（fetchData/formatCapsule/formatPanel），宿主注入共享图表工具（utils），密钥配置链注入、按天分片 JSONL 历史、热更新可选；内置 OpenCode Go / DeepSeek 官方 / 智谱 Coding Plan (CN) 适配器

Browser verification for DSH plugin development in an isolated environment: throwaway DSH_HOME with its own profile, port and browser instance. DSH 插件开发的隔离环境浏览器验证 skill：临时 DSH_HOME + 独立 verify_<随机> profile 双重隔离，一键拉起隔离 dsh web（自动构建/挂载/启动/清理），不污染正在使用的 web profile
Point the current session's right-sidebar file tree at a git worktree without changing the session cwd. 把某个 git worktree 登记给当前会话，使该会话的官方右侧栏文件树根指向该 worktree；会话 cwd 不变。官方提供原生 worktree 会话能力即退役的过渡适配层。

plugins.name: @mrweicodes/dsh-loop-guard
plugins.description: Thinking-loop guard for dsh: observes the llm/stream waterfall and breaks a model that degrades into a loop. Detects two per-call shapes (reasoning-only calls, restated-material calls) and re-fires instead of latching; plus two mid-stream breakers that end a single degenerate call (maxRepeatedText / maxRepeatedCycleChars for visible output, maxRepeatedReasoningCycleChars for a reasoning bleed), which no post-call detector can reach — the reasoning rule is what ends the never-finishing turn of issue #5976. Ships an offline session analyzer that replays a session jsonl through the same detector. Compatible with every published dsh line from 0.1.2-rc.1 through 0.2.0-rc.1.

自动识别本机 Ollama 服务并接入 DSH：启动后周期探测 Ollama 原生接口 /api/tags（默认 http://localhost:11434），在线则自动把 Ollama 注册为 OpenAI 兼容 Provider（写入 llm-pi-ai 的 providers 配置），WebUI Models 页即可选择 Ollama 模型并修改参数；模型有增删时自动同步。另提供 WebUI「设置 → Ollama 设置」面板在线修改插件配置（持久化到 DSH_HOME/ollama-config.json，保存即生效）。零原生依赖、零构建、纯宿主端。

在 WebUI 设置页可视化分析会话(逐回合/错误统计),并支持按回合「回退」——从选定回合之后派生干净的续接会话(官方 session.fork),等效于移除失败消息后继续对话

官方 DSH 右侧栏（dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right）的 tab 类型插件：以 priority "extension" 档接管官方 kind "files" 文件树 tab，补上官方没有的任意路径上溯浏览、路径框跳转与右键菜单（官方 @ 引用、编辑、另存为、复制路径）；并新增文本编辑 tab 类型 sidebar-extend.edit（官方预览为只读）。文档预览、终端与后台任务已交由官方实现，本插件不再自带。零依赖、零构建，纯 JS 注入。

WebUI 右侧侧边栏：① 文件资源管理器（工作区根 sandboxPolicy.workspaceRoot 为默认根、目录优先/隐藏文件灰显、支持上级任意路径浏览）；② 文件预览/编辑（受控文本区 + 图片/PDF/MD 预览、保存回写）；③ 内嵌浏览器（沙箱 iframe + 地址栏导航）；④ CMD 终端（轻量 SSE 流 + cmd.exe 逐行执行）；⑤ 任务管理（后台任务列表/输出/停止）。零原生依赖、零构建，纯 JS 注入。参考/复刻自第三方插件 DSH Better Sidebar（omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar），本版内置其资源管理/文件预览/浏览器/终端/任务五项核心能力。
WebUI 用量统计（统一安装/卸载）：① 设置页「用量统计」面板——扫描解码全部会话日志，按模型汇总 token 用量与费用估算（价格表可编辑）、逐回合明细；② 对话消息行「本次token」显示——每条已完成助手消息上方常驻显示该回合实际消耗的 token（输入/输出/缓存/思考）。不修改任何官方文件

自动识别本机 Ollama 服务并接入 DSH：启动后周期探测 Ollama 原生接口 /api/tags（默认 http://localhost:11434），在线则自动把 Ollama 注册为 OpenAI 兼容 Provider（写入 llm-pi-ai 的 providers 配置），WebUI Models 页即可选择 Ollama 模型并修改参数；模型有增删时自动同步。另提供 WebUI「设置 → Ollama 设置」面板在线修改插件配置（持久化到 DSH_HOME/ollama-config.json，保存即生效）。零原生依赖、零构建、纯宿主端。
用户规则注入插件 - 每次对话自动注入自定义 system prompt (类似 TRAE Work 的规则功能)

在 WebUI 设置页可视化分析会话(逐回合/错误统计),并支持按回合「回退」——从选定回合之后派生干净的续接会话(官方 session.fork),等效于移除失败消息后继续对话

WebUI 用量统计（统一安装/卸载）：① 设置页「用量统计」面板——扫描解码全部会话日志，按模型汇总 token 用量与费用估算（价格表可编辑）、逐回合明细；② 对话消息行「本次token」显示——每条已完成助手消息上方常驻显示该回合实际消耗的 token（输入/输出/缓存/思考）。不修改任何官方文件

WebUI 右侧侧边栏：① 文件资源管理器（工作区根 sandboxPolicy.workspaceRoot 为默认根、目录优先/隐藏文件灰显、支持上级任意路径浏览）；② 文件预览/编辑（受控文本区 + 图片/PDF/MD 预览、保存回写）；③ 内嵌浏览器（沙箱 iframe + 地址栏导航）；④ CMD 终端（轻量 SSE 流 + cmd.exe 逐行执行）；⑤ 任务管理（后台任务列表/输出/停止）。零原生依赖、零构建，纯 JS 注入。参考/复刻自第三方插件 DSH Better Sidebar（omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar），本版内置其资源管理/文件预览/浏览器/终端/任务五项核心能力。
WebUI 用量统计（统一安装/卸载）：① 设置页「用量统计」面板——扫描解码全部会话日志，按模型汇总 token 用量与费用估算（价格表可编辑）、逐回合明细；② 对话消息行「本次token」显示——每条已完成助手消息上方常驻显示该回合实际消耗的 token（输入/输出/缓存/思考）。不修改任何官方文件
